BiblicalUsage: The word is to be good, to be pleasing, in Aramaic. When Daniel was lifted out of the lions' den unhurt, the king was exceeding glad for him, because Daniel believed in his God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the king's gladness was God's doing: the lions did no hurt, and the man who believed walked out whole.
